title: Launch an L1
summary: Your own Avalanche L1 on Fuji in minutes
description: Launches a Subnet-EVM L1 on Fuji through the Builder Hub's Quick L1 service: subnet, chain, Validator Manager on the C-Chain, a managed validator node, conversion to an L1, and optionally ICM with a managed relayer to the C-Chain. The result binds the `l1` network for every other blueprint.
prompts: Launch my own blockchain on Avalanche
Create an L1 with its own gas token
I need a testnet chain with ICM to the C-Chain for my app

primary.description: Fuji C-Chain, where the Validator Manager lives

params.name: tokenSymbol
params.description: Symbol of the native gas token

params.name: owner
params.description: Owns the Validator Manager, gets the genesis allocation, and administers precompiles

params.name: validatorMode
params.description: poa (owner-managed validators) or erc20-pos (anyone can stake a fresh staking token)

params.name: nativeMinter
params.description: Enable the Native Minter precompile; required by usdc-gas-l1

params.name: interoperability
params.description: Enable Warp and preinstall Teleporter; required by every ICM blueprint

params.name: managedRelayer
params.description: Run a managed ICM relayer to the C-Chain and bridge demo MockUSDC; needs interoperability

prerequisites: A signed-in Builder Hub account: the Quick L1 API ties every L1 to a user
Managed nodes expire after 3 days on testnet; relaunch for longer tests

steps.title: Wait for the chain to be live

review: The owner is the builder's address: it receives the genesis allocation and administers the Validator Manager and precompiles.
interoperability is on whenever the builder plans ICM or ICTT; it cannot be added after genesis without a network upgrade.
managedRelayer requires interoperability; the service rejects the request otherwise.
The builder knows the managed node and explorer expire after 3 days on testnet.

frontend.summary: Launch your own Avalanche L1 from a short form and watch it come to life.
audience: Builders and teams launching a test L1
Their community, who add the new chain to their wallets
journeys: A short form: chain name and token symbol, with advanced options folded away.
A live launch tracker in plain steps (creating your chain, starting its validator, turning it into an L1), each with its transactions linked.
When it's live: the chain's name and token, 'Add to wallet', RPC and explorer links, and what to build next.
Say up front that test L1s last 3 days, and offer a relaunch.
flows: POST the inputs to /api/quick-l1/deploy (session required), then poll /api/quick-l1/status/<jobId> about every 2 seconds.
Render progress from DEPLOYMENT_STEPS and STEP_LABEL in lib/quick-l1/types.ts, hiding MANAGED_RELAYER_ONLY_STEPS and ERC20_POS_ONLY_STEPS when those options are off.
Show each step's transactions from evidence, linked to the explorer for its chain.
When complete, offer 'Add to wallet' with evmChainId and rpcUrl, and suggest icm-messenger, ictt-token-bridge or usdc-gas-l1.
